steps: Dice the onion finely and mince the garlic cloves.
Trim the zucchini and cut into small 1 cm cubes.
Cut the white fish (cod) into 3 cm chunks, removing any bones.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Add the rice and zucchini; stir for 1 minute to coat.
Pour in the unsalted chicken broth and bring to a simmer; cover and cook 15 minutes.
Lay the cod chunks over the rice; cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes, until fish flakes easily.
Drizzle with lemon juice and scatter fresh dill over the top.
Flake the cod into smaller pieces before serving. Makes 4 family portions; refrigerate up to 2 days.
